description.en: Čebelar Anton swears by propolis and honey, but he knows the pharmacy shelf too: the words for the longer illnesses, the remedies and how to take them.
description.de: Čebelar Anton schwört auf Propolis und Honig, aber er kennt auch das Apothekenregal: die Wörter für die längeren Krankheiten, die Heilmittel und wie man sie nimmt.
description.it: Čebelar Anton giura su propoli e miele, ma conosce anche lo scaffale della farmacia: le parole per le malattie più lunghe, i rimedi e come prenderli.

review: sl, de, it: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker; the Slovene forms checked with fran.si (SP2001) and Sloleks

words.example_sl: Lovec Jože o svoji bolezni ne govori rad.
words.example_en: Lovec Jože doesn't like talking about his illness.
words.example_de: Lovec Jože spricht nicht gern über seine Krankheit.
words.example_it: Lovec Jože non parla volentieri della sua malattia.
words.note: The e drops: bolezen, bolezni (like pesem, pesmi). Bolan is the adjective: ill.
words.note_de: Das e fällt weg: bolezen, bolezni (wie pesem, pesmi). Bolan ist das Adjektiv: krank.
words.note_it: La e cade: bolezen, bolezni (come pesem, pesmi). Bolan è l'aggettivo: malato.

words.example_sl: Stari Janez ima sladkorno bolezen, zato ne sme jesti sladkarij.
words.example_en: Stari Janez has diabetes, so he mustn't eat sweets.
words.example_de: Stari Janez hat Diabetes, deshalb darf er keine Süßigkeiten essen.
words.example_it: Stari Janez ha il diabete, quindi non può mangiare dolci.
words.note: Literally 'the sugar illness', from sladkor. Doctors also say diabetes.
words.note_de: Wörtlich „die Zuckerkrankheit“, von sladkor. Ärzte sagen auch diabetes.
words.note_it: Letteralmente «la malattia dello zucchero», da sladkor. I medici dicono anche diabetes.

words.example_sl: Zala ima astmo, a vseeno rada teče.
words.example_en: Zala has asthma, but she still loves running.
words.example_de: Zala hat Asthma, rennt aber trotzdem gern.
words.example_it: Zala ha l'asma, ma le piace lo stesso correre.
words.note: Feminine in Slovene (ta astma), neuter in German (das Asthma).
words.note_de: Im Slowenischen weiblich (ta astma), im Deutschen sächlich (das Asthma).
words.note_it: Femminile come in italiano: ta astma, l'asma.

words.example_sl: Ko piha burja, ima Teta Ančka migreno.
words.example_en: When the bora blows, Teta Ančka gets a migraine.
words.example_de: Wenn die Bora weht, bekommt Teta Ančka Migräne.
words.example_it: Quando soffia la bora, Teta Ančka ha l'emicrania.

words.example_sl: Po veselici je imel Luka hud glavobol.
words.example_en: After the village dance Luka had a bad headache.
words.example_de: Nach dem Dorffest hatte Luka starke Kopfschmerzen.
words.example_it: Dopo la festa del paese Luka aveva un forte mal di testa.
words.note: Glava (head) + bol (pain). One also says boli me glava, my head hurts.
words.note_de: Glava (Kopf) + bol (Schmerz). Man sagt auch boli me glava, mir tut der Kopf weh.
words.note_it: Glava (testa) + bol (dolore). Si dice anche boli me glava, mi fa male la testa.

words.example_sl: Rana je rdeča in vroča, to je okužba.
words.example_en: The wound is red and hot: that's an infection.
words.example_de: Die Wunde ist rot und heiß, das ist eine Infektion.
words.example_it: La ferita è rossa e calda: è un'infezione.
words.note: The verb is okužiti (to infect); okužen, infected.
words.note_de: Das Verb ist okužiti (anstecken, infizieren); okužen, infiziert.
words.note_it: Il verbo è okužiti (infettare, contagiare); okužen, infetto.

words.example_sl: Zala ima vnetje ušes in ne gre v šolo.
words.example_en: Zala has an ear infection and isn't going to school.
words.example_de: Zala hat eine Ohrenentzündung und geht nicht in die Schule.
words.example_it: Zala ha l'otite e non va a scuola.
words.note: With the genitive of the part: vnetje grla (a sore throat), vnetje ušes (an ear infection).
words.note_de: Mit dem Genitiv des Körperteils: vnetje grla (Halsentzündung), vnetje ušes (Ohrenentzündung).
words.note_it: Col genitivo della parte: vnetje grla (mal di gola, faringite), vnetje ušes (otite).

words.example_sl: Ponoči je Nejca tresla mrzlica, zjutraj pa je imel vročino.
words.example_en: In the night Nejc had the shivers, and in the morning a fever.
words.example_de: In der Nacht hatte Nejc Schüttelfrost, am Morgen dann Fieber.
words.example_it: Di notte Nejc aveva i brividi, e la mattina la febbre.
words.note: Mrzlica is the subject: trese me mrzlica, literally 'the chills shake me'.
words.note_de: Mrzlica ist das Subjekt: trese me mrzlica, wörtlich „der Schüttelfrost schüttelt mich“.
words.note_it: Mrzlica è il soggetto: trese me mrzlica, letteralmente «i brividi mi scuotono».

words.example_sl: Tine je bruhal, ker je pojedel preveč češenj.
words.example_en: Tine threw up because he had eaten too many cherries.
words.example_de: Tine hat sich übergeben, weil er zu viele Kirschen gegessen hatte.
words.example_it: Tine ha vomitato perché aveva mangiato troppe ciliegie.
words.note: Imperfective: bruham, bruhal; perfective izbruhati.
words.note_de: Imperfektiv: bruham, bruhal; perfektiv izbruhati.
words.note_it: Imperfettivo: bruham, bruhal; perfettivo izbruhati.

words.example_sl: Gripa je zelo nalezljiva, zato ostani doma.
words.example_en: Flu is very contagious, so stay at home.
words.example_de: Grippe ist sehr ansteckend, also bleib zu Hause.
words.example_it: L'influenza è molto contagiosa, quindi resta a casa.
words.note: From nalesti se (to catch an illness from someone); the feminine is nalezljiva.
words.note_de: Von nalesti se (sich anstecken); die weibliche Form ist nalezljiva.
words.note_it: Da nalesti se (prendersi una malattia da qualcuno); il femminile è nalezljiva.

words.example_sl: Tine ima drisko, zato pije samo čaj.
words.example_en: Tine has diarrhoea, so he's only drinking tea.
words.example_de: Tine hat Durchfall, deshalb trinkt er nur Tee.
words.example_it: Tine ha la diarrea, quindi beve solo tè.
words.note: Imeti drisko (the accusative): to have diarrhoea.
words.note_de: Imeti drisko (Akkusativ): Durchfall haben.
words.note_it: Imeti drisko (accusativo): avere la diarrea.

words.example_sl: Kovač Tone ima na roki staro opeklino.
words.example_en: Kovač Tone has an old burn on his hand.
words.example_de: Kovač Tone hat eine alte Brandwunde an der Hand.
words.example_it: Kovač Tone ha una vecchia ustione sulla mano.
words.note: From opeči se, to burn oneself. Sončne opekline: sunburn.
words.note_de: Von opeči se, sich verbrennen. Sončne opekline: Sonnenbrand.
words.note_it: Da opeči se, scottarsi. Sončne opekline: scottature solari.

words.example_sl: Po srčnem napadu Mlinar France ne kadi več.
words.example_en: Since his heart attack Mlinar France doesn't smoke any more.
words.example_de: Seit seinem Herzinfarkt raucht Mlinar France nicht mehr.
words.example_it: Dopo l'infarto Mlinar France non fuma più.
words.note: Srce, the heart; doctors also say infarkt. Dobiti srčni napad: to have a heart attack.
words.note_de: Srce, das Herz; Ärzte sagen auch infarkt. Dobiti srčni napad: einen Herzinfarkt bekommen.
words.note_it: Srce, il cuore; i medici dicono anche infarkt. Dobiti srčni napad: avere un infarto.

words.example_sl: Po treh dneh v postelji je Nejc ozdravel.
words.example_en: After three days in bed Nejc got well.
words.example_de: Nach drei Tagen im Bett war Nejc wieder gesund.
words.example_it: Dopo tre giorni a letto Nejc è guarito.
words.note: Perfective: ozdravim, ozdravel. Hitro ozdravi! Get well soon! (Ozdraviti, with an i, is to cure someone.)
words.note_de: Perfektiv: ozdravim, ozdravel. Hitro ozdravi! Gute Besserung! (Ozdraviti, mit i, heißt jemanden heilen.)
words.note_it: Perfettivo: ozdravim, ozdravel. Hitro ozdravi! Guarisci presto! (Ozdraviti, con la i, è guarire qualcuno.)

words.example_sl: Za gripo antibiotik ne pomaga, pravi zdravnica.
words.example_en: Antibiotics don't help with the flu, the doctor says.
words.example_de: Bei Grippe hilft kein Antibiotikum, sagt die Ärztin.
words.example_it: Per l'influenza l'antibiotico non serve, dice la dottoressa.
words.note: Jemati antibiotike: to be on antibiotics (the plural, as in English).
words.note_de: Jemati antibiotike: Antibiotika nehmen (im Plural).
words.note_it: Jemati antibiotike: prendere gli antibiotici (al plurale).

words.example_sl: Babica da Tinetu žlico sirupa za kašelj.
words.example_en: Grandma gives Tine a spoonful of cough syrup.
words.example_de: Die Oma gibt Tine einen Löffel Hustensaft.
words.example_it: La nonna dà a Tine un cucchiaio di sciroppo per la tosse.
words.note: Also the sweet drink: bezgov sirup, elderflower cordial.
words.note_de: Auch das süße Getränk: bezgov sirup, Holundersirup.
words.note_it: Anche la bevanda dolce: bezgov sirup, sciroppo di sambuco.

words.example_sl: Na pik daj malo mazila, pa bo bolje.
words.example_en: Put a little ointment on the sting and it'll get better.
words.example_de: Tu ein bisschen Salbe auf den Stich, dann wird es besser.
words.example_it: Metti un po' di pomata sulla puntura e andrà meglio.
words.note: From mazati, to spread or rub on: namazati rano z mazilom.
words.note_de: Von mazati, schmieren, einreiben: namazati rano z mazilom, die Wunde mit Salbe einreiben.
words.note_it: Da mazati, spalmare: namazati rano z mazilom, spalmare la pomata sulla ferita.

words.example_sl: Babica Micka si vsak večer da kapljice v oči.
words.example_en: Every evening Babica Micka puts drops in her eyes.
words.example_de: Babica Micka gibt sich jeden Abend Tropfen in die Augen.
words.example_it: Ogni sera Babica Micka si mette le gocce negli occhi.
words.note: Medicine comes as kapljice: kapljice za oči (eye drops), za nos (nose drops).
words.note_de: Medizin in Tropfen sind kapljice: kapljice za oči (Augentropfen), za nos (Nasentropfen).
words.note_it: Le gocce di medicina sono kapljice: kapljice za oči (collirio), za nos (gocce per il naso).

words.example_sl: Sadje ima veliko vitaminov, pravi Učiteljica Mojca.
words.example_en: Fruit has lots of vitamins, says Učiteljica Mojca.
words.example_de: Obst hat viele Vitamine, sagt Učiteljica Mojca.
words.example_it: La frutta ha tante vitamine, dice Učiteljica Mojca.
words.note: Masculine in Slovene (en vitamin), feminine in Italian (la vitamina).
words.note_de: Maskulin wie im Deutschen: en vitamin, ein Vitamin (dort sächlich).
words.note_it: Maschile in sloveno (en vitamin), femminile in italiano (la vitamina).

words.example_sl: Anton že vse življenje zdravi kašelj z medom.
words.example_en: All his life Anton has treated a cough with honey.
words.example_de: Anton behandelt Husten schon sein ganzes Leben mit Honig.
words.example_it: Da sempre Anton cura la tosse con il miele.
words.note: Imperfective (zdravim); zdraviti se, to be under treatment. Perfective ozdraviti, to cure.
words.note_de: Imperfektiv (zdravim); zdraviti se, in Behandlung sein. Perfektiv ozdraviti, heilen.
words.note_it: Imperfettivo (zdravim); zdraviti se, essere in cura. Perfettivo ozdraviti, guarire qualcuno.

words.example_sl: Mlinar France je po operaciji dva tedna ležal doma.
words.example_en: After the operation Mlinar France lay at home for two weeks.
words.example_de: Nach der Operation lag Mlinar France zwei Wochen zu Hause.
words.example_it: Dopo l'operazione Mlinar France è rimasto a letto a casa per due settimane.
words.note: Iti na operacijo: to have an operation. The surgeon is kirurg.
words.note_de: Iti na operacijo: sich operieren lassen. Der Chirurg ist kirurg.
words.note_it: Iti na operacijo: farsi operare. Il chirurgo è kirurg.

words.example_sl: Lekarnar je rekel, naj tablete jemljem zjutraj in zvečer.
words.example_en: The pharmacist said I should take the tablets morning and evening.
words.example_de: Der Apotheker hat gesagt, ich soll die Tabletten morgens und abends nehmen.
words.example_it: Il farmacista ha detto di prendere le pastiglie la mattina e la sera.
words.note: A woman is lekarnarka. The shop is lekarna.
words.note_de: Eine Frau ist lekarnarka. Das Geschäft ist lekarna.
words.note_it: Una donna è lekarnarka. Il negozio è lekarna.

words.example_sl: Ko Tineta boli trebuh, mu babica skuha kamilico.
words.example_en: When Tine has a tummy ache, Grandma makes him camomile tea.
words.example_de: Wenn Tine Bauchweh hat, kocht ihm die Oma Kamillentee.
words.example_it: Quando Tine ha mal di pancia, la nonna gli fa una camomilla.
words.note: The flower and the tea: skuhati kamilico, to make camomile tea (as Italian una camomilla).
words.note_de: Die Blume und der Tee: skuhati kamilico, Kamillentee kochen.
words.note_it: Il fiore e la tisana: skuhati kamilico, fare una camomilla.

words.example_sl: Za vsako bolezen ima Anton propolis in med.
words.example_en: Anton has propolis and honey for every illness.
words.example_de: Anton hat für jede Krankheit Propolis und Honig.
words.example_it: Anton ha propoli e miele per ogni malattia.
words.note: The resin bees seal the hive with; sold as drops or spray for the throat. Masculine, no plural.
words.note_de: Das Harz, mit dem die Bienen den Stock abdichten; als Tropfen oder Spray für den Hals verkauft. Maskulin, kein Plural.
words.note_it: La resina con cui le api sigillano l'arnia; si vende in gocce o spray per la gola. Maschile, niente plurale.
